entities.summary: Naghi Saleh oglu Sheykhzamanli, also known as Naki Keykurun, was an Azerbaijani political figure and the head of the counterintelligence service of Azerbaijan Democratic Republic within the fourth and fifth cabinets led by Nasib Yusifbeyli.
